# Whit Fitness: full fact sheet

Last updated: 2026-10-22. Canonical site: https://whit-fitness.com/

## Identity
- Name: Whit Fitness (formerly CrossFit Evviva; same gym, same owners and coaches, new name)
- Type: CrossFit affiliate, HYROX training gym, strength and conditioning gym
- Address: 277 Blair Blvd, Eugene, OR 97402, USA (Whiteaker neighborhood, Eugene, Oregon)
- Coordinates: 44.0569023, -123.1101159
- Phone/text: (458) 234-3673
- Email: contact.crossfitevviva@gmail.com
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=10535944655785304145
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/whit.fitness_eugene/
- Google rating: 5.0 from 70 reviews
- Serves: Eugene, Springfield, the Whiteaker and Lane County

## Hours
Mon–Thu 5:00am–7:30pm · Fri 5:00am–6:30pm · Sat 8:00–11:00am · Sun 8:30am–1:00pm · members 24/7 by keycode

## Class schedule
- CrossFit: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday at 5:00am, 6:00am, 9:00am, 12:00pm, 4:30pm and 5:30pm (60 min)
- HYROX: Wednesday at 5:00am, 6:00am, 9:00am, 12:00pm, 4:30pm and 5:30pm; Saturday at 8:00am and 9:15am (75 min); Sunday at 9:30am
- Lift + Mobility: Sunday at 8:30am
- Vitality 55+: Tuesday and Thursday at 10:00am
- ATP youth strength & athletic development: Monday–Thursday at 6:30pm (booked through Upper Hand)
- Open gym: members have 24/7 keycode access; Sunday open gym 12:00–1:00pm

## Pricing
- Unlimited membership: $160/month (all CrossFit and HYROX classes, open gym, 24/7 access)
- Couples unlimited: $270/month
- HYROX membership (2 classes/week): $120/month
- Open gym: $100/month
- Drop-in class: $25
- One-week pass: $60
- On-Ramp (one-to-one intro for new CrossFitters): $50 per session ($60 for a couple)
- First HYROX class: free
- Personal training consultation: free
- Student and military discounts available
- ATP youth classes (booked through Upper Hand, separate from gym memberships): $20 drop-in, $175 for 10 classes, $300 for 20 classes, $120/month membership

- Book any class: https://crossfitevviva.wodify.com/OnlineSalesPage/Main?q=Classes%7CLocationId%3D656

## Facility
24/7 member keycode access, showers, lockers, changing room, lounge with Wi-Fi work space, kids' room, childcare Monday/Wednesday/Friday at 9am, 50 feet of turf for sled pushes and pulls, 12 rowers, 3 SkiErgs and 9 Echo bikes.

## Who it's good for
Beginners and experienced athletes, HYROX racers, adults 55+ who want strength and balance, parents (kids welcome, childcare available), middle and high school athletes, and visitors who want to drop in while in Eugene.

## Frequently asked questions
### What are your hours?
Coaches are in Monday to Thursday 5:00am–7:30pm, Friday 5:00am–6:30pm, Saturday 8:00–11:00am and Sunday 8:30am–1:00pm. Members can also train any time with their 24/7 keycode.

### Where is Whit Fitness?
277 Blair Blvd, Eugene, OR 97402, in the Whiteaker neighborhood a few minutes from downtown Eugene. We serve members from across Eugene and Springfield.

### What kind of gym is Whit Fitness?
A coached gym. Every class is led by a coach. We run CrossFit classes, HYROX race training, Vitality (a strength and balance class for adults 55+), youth athletic training with our partner ATP, and one-to-one personal training. We're a CrossFit affiliate, still listed on CrossFit.com as CrossFit Evviva.

### Do I need to be fit or have experience to start?
No. Every program is built for beginners too. New CrossFit members start with On-Ramp: one to four one-to-one sessions with a coach ($50 each, or $60 for a couple) before joining class. HYROX and Vitality 55+ don't need an On-Ramp. Your first HYROX class is free.

### Is Whit Fitness the same gym as CrossFit Evviva?
Yes. CrossFit Evviva is now Whit Fitness, at 277 Blair Blvd in Eugene. We're still a CrossFit affiliate, listed as CrossFit Evviva on CrossFit.com, and we've added HYROX, Vitality 55+ and youth training.

### Can I drop in for a class?
Yes. A single class is $25 and a full week pass is $60. Book on our class calendar in Wodify. If you haven't done CrossFit or functional fitness before, we'll ask you to do one On-Ramp session first.

### What should I bring?
Comfortable workout clothes, training shoes and a water bottle. The lounge has lockers, a shower and a changing room if you're heading to work after.

### Is there childcare?
Yes, childcare runs Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 9am. Kids are welcome at every class, and outside childcare times parents are responsible for their kids. There's a kids' room in the gym.

### Do you have programs for kids and teens?
Yes. Middle and high school athletes train with ATP, our youth sports performance program, Monday to Thursday at 6:30pm. Classes are $20 to drop in or $120 a month, booked through Upper Hand. See ATP youth training for passes, personal training and team sessions.

### How does the 24/7 keycode work?
Members get a keycode so they can train any time, including outside class and open gym hours.

### What's the difference between CrossFit and HYROX classes?
CrossFit classes mix weightlifting, gymnastics and conditioning. HYROX classes focus on running and machine and sled work, with no barbells or advanced gymnastics. Unlimited members can do both.

### Do you offer student or military discounts?
Yes, for both. Call or text (458) 234-3673 and we'll set it up.

### How do I pause or cancel my membership?
Contact us by phone, text or email and tell us whether you'd like to pause or cancel. Our staff will finalize it with you.
